US regulators question Tesla on Cybercab's human control options

The U.S. National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) has ordered Tesla to answer questions by September 30 regarding the self-certification of its autonomous Cybercab robotaxi. NHTSA is investigating whether Tesla properly certified the vehicle, specifically inquiring about the availability of human control options. The agency is seeking to determine if the Cybercab meets federal safety standards for autonomous vehicles. The investigation comes as Tesla prepares to launch its robotaxi service.
